definitions.explanation: Outward display or embellishment that lacks substance; putting on a showy front to conceal the reality underneath.

examples.japanese: {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
{虚飾|きょしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧がしたい。
examples.english: I want to live without pretense.

examples.japanese: {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧、⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: Tired of a society full of false show, I moved to the countryside.

notes:
A compound of {虚|きょ} (empty, vain) and {飾|しょく} (decoration, adornment). Describes the negative quality of ornamenting or embellishing to hide a lack of substance. Often used in literary and critical contexts.

USAGE:
Frequently appears in the negative — {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without pretense) and {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{排|はい}する (to reject ostentation) — to praise honesty and simplicity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ — to cast off pretense
- {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — without pretense, honest
- {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ — full of false show
- {虚飾|きょしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{排|はい}する — to reject ostentation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧ — vanity, showing off; more everyday and personal, while {虚飾|きょしょく} is broader and more literary
- ⟦{虚栄|きょえい}→虚栄：09464_kyoei⟧ — vanity; focuses on the desire for admiration, while {虚飾|きょしょく} emphasizes the outward display itself
